title: Wet-Mix vs Dry-Mix Shotcrete and Pinjin Sprayers
seoTitle: Wet-Mix vs Dry-Mix Shotcrete | Pinjin Sprayers
description: Pinjin spraying machines are wet hose sprayers with printed particle and hose rows — not dry-mix gunite robots and not trailer concrete pumps. Hydraulic rows: ≤8 mm, 5 or 7 m³/h. Diesel sprayer: ≤6 mm. M9 plaster: ≤4 mm.
primaryKeyword: wet mix vs dry mix shotcrete
secondaryKeywords: dry mix gunite vs wet shotcrete

answerBlock.what: Dry-mix (gunite) feeds dry material to the nozzle and adds water there. Wet-mix pumps a premixed wet material and sprays it. Pinjin spraying machines are wet hose sprayers: hydraulic concrete sprayers list 5 m³/h or 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm; diesel sprayer lists 5 m³/h, particle ≤6 mm, 28/32 HP; M9 plaster lists 30 L/min, ≤4 mm, 25 mm hose. They are not dry-mix robots, not trailer concrete pumps, and not a substitute for the ‘fine stone pump vs mortar sprayer’ pipeline article.
answerBlock.who: Tunnel or slope buyers who typed wet-mix/dry-mix shotcrete and landed on a Pinjin sprayer or trailer pump page.
factors: Wet hose spray vs dry gunite — Pinjin lists the first
Particle ≤8 mm / ≤6 mm / ≤4 mm versus trailer-pump centimetre stone
380 V dual-motor vs diesel 28/32 HP sprayer
No rebound percentage or shotcrete-robot SKU is published

faqs.question: Does Pinjin sell a dry-mix gunite machine?
faqs.answer: No dry-mix or gunite robot is listed. Catalogue sprayers pump premixed mortar, plaster or listed concrete through a spray hose. If the inquiry is dry material + nozzle water, that is not a Pinjin SKU.

faqs.question: Is a wet-mix sprayer the same as a fine-stone trailer pump?
faqs.answer: No. Sprayers list particle ≤8 mm, ≤6 mm or ≤4 mm and a spray hose. Trailer pumps list centimetre-class aggregate and a pipeline. Use the spraying hub or the pump hub, not both names on one machine. The separate vs-mortar-sprayer article covers pipeline versus spray finishing.

faqs.question: Which Pinjin sprayer is the wet-mix shotcrete unit for tunnels?
faqs.answer: None is named ‘shotcrete robot’. Hydraulic 5 m³/h (100 m / 50 m, ≤8 mm) and 7 m³/h (150 m / 70 m, ≤8 mm) are 380 V hose sprayers. Diesel sprayer: 5 m³/h, ≤6 mm, 80 m / 40 m, no grid. We do not publish rebound %, accelerator dosing or lining thickness.
